decision_rationale: The paper describes a GPT-style autoregressive model used for candidate generation and reports a fine-tuned GPT model as the best generator. It also states GPT pre-training on a large AMPSphere corpus and transfer learning from genomic data.
evidence_snippet: “GPT pre-training”; “GPT-style autoregressive model”; “The fine-tuned GPT model emerged as the most effective architecture for generating candidates”,
